rules.behavior: Reports Hooks called outside a React component or custom Hook, or along a conditional execution path.
rules.runtime_rationale: React relies on stable Hook call order to associate state with the same component invocation.
positive_examples: Calling useState after an early return in a component.
false_positive_traps: Hooks called unconditionally at the component top level must remain valid after formatting and identifier renames.
out_of_scope: Whether a custom Hook performs useful work or follows project naming style.

rules.behavior: Reports unconditional state updates executed while a React component is rendering.
rules.runtime_rationale: An unconditional render-time state update can trigger a render loop before React can commit the result.
positive_examples: Calling a useState setter directly in the component body.
false_positive_traps: A setter called from an event handler is deferred until interaction and must not be reported as a render-time update.
out_of_scope: State updates performed by external stores whose APIs are not recognized by the upstream React rule.

rules.behavior: Reports image-like JSX elements that do not provide alternative text through a supported attribute.
rules.runtime_rationale: Assistive technologies require an alternative description or an explicit empty alternative for decorative images.
positive_examples: An img element with a src attribute and no alt attribute.
false_positive_traps: An image with descriptive alt text or an explicit empty alt for decoration must not be reported as missing alt text.
out_of_scope: Whether alternative text accurately describes rendered visual content.

rules.behavior: Provides a conservative missing-alt fallback when the managed JSX accessibility analyzer cannot complete.
rules.runtime_rationale: A missing alternative prevents non-visual users from receiving equivalent image information.
positive_examples: A literal img opening element with no alt attribute.
false_positive_traps: The fallback is suppressed whenever managed jsx-a11y evidence completes, and img elements with an alt attribute are not reported.
out_of_scope: Spread-provided attributes, custom image components, and semantic quality of alternative text.
